sessions.title: Isabelle Huppert’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The legendary actor returns to Closet, where she shares her love for independent American gems such as Barbara Loden’s Wanda and Michael Roemer’s Nothing but a Man, talks about Roberto Rossellini’s work with Ingrid Bergman, and selects Italian cinema classics I Knew Her Well and Juliet of the Spirits.
